sub_site: serum (chronic spontaneous urticaria, vitamin D insufficient group); stool not extracted

evidence.quote: genomic DNA was isolated from 1 mL serum with a QIAmp DNA blood mini kit
the universal eubacterial primers of a conserved V3–V4 region of the 16S rRNA gene

notes: 72 sera; only 30 (VDI) + 4 (non-VDI) amplified adequately; serum profile analysed only for the 30 VDI sera. Only top-3 serum genera ranked (B-C-P 40.95%, Acinetobacter, Aquabacterium), so top5 left empty. Composite SILVA name recorded verbatim as spelled in E0020 (spaced en-dashes). No negative controls or decontamination described.
